sections.title: How to enroll
sections.body:
1. Register
Complete the school admission form and present the required documents. Use CAPITAL letters, as requested on the school Linktree.

2. Assessment and interview
New students and transferees: academic assessment, guidance interview, school clinic, uniform/books and ID photo. Returning students: school clinic, uniform/books and ID photo.

3. Visit the Registrar
The Registrar checks documents, encodes student data and confirms enrollment.

4. Process payment
Have the fees assessed and pay through the Finance Office.

5. Collect books and uniform
Follow the school’s instructions for the release of books and the school uniform.

Before your visit
Ask the Registrar for the exact document checklist, assessment schedule and available places for your grade level. Completing the online form starts registration; follow the remaining school steps to confirm enrollment.

sections.title: Academic programs
sections.body:
The 2026–2027 school flyer lists:
• Preschool
• Grade School
• Junior High School
• Senior High School

Senior High School
The flyer features the Strengthened Senior High School Program and describes SJBPS as a pilot school in Taytay.

Junior High School
The flyer lists a ₱9,000 ESC grantee subsidy. Ask the Registrar about eligibility and availability.

sections.title: Fees & payment
sections.body:
Published school fees · S.Y. 2026–2027
Grade 7: ₱32,553.75
Grade 8: ₱33,339.35
Grade 9: ₱34,165.35
Grade 10: ₱35,031.65

Payment options
Cash, semestral, quarterly or monthly. The cash plan lists a 5% discount on tuition only. Monthly installments are scheduled on the 2nd day, July–February; use the PDF for grade-specific amounts and dates.

Senior High School
The standard fee table lists ₱17,500 for Grades 11 and 12. A separate promo panel lists 100% free tuition for students from public schools and ₱350/month for students from private schools with an SHS voucher. Confirm eligibility and which fee schedule applies with the school.

Other notes
Books and uniforms are paid separately. The ₱1,000 reservation fee is non-refundable and deducted from school fees upon enrollment. Personal checks are not accepted. Other discounts do not apply to the Grade 11–12 no-top-up promo.

sections.title: Uniforms & supplies
sections.body:
Choose the uniform for the student’s school level and size. The supplied 2026–2027 price list covers Preschool–Elementary, Junior High, Senior High, PE and activity wear.

Selected listed prices
PE shirt: ₱360–₱500
Activity shirt: ₱310–₱430
School logo: ₱50
SHS patch: ₱45

Daily uniforms, trousers, shorts and socks have separate size-based prices. Check the original five-page list for the correct item and size. Books and uniforms are paid separately from school fees.

sections.title: Vision & mission
sections.body:
Vision
A globally academically competent community that embodies Christ’s teachings.

Mission
To witness Christ through quality Catholic education, proclaim Gospel values and develop 21st-century competencies in the Johannine community, in the spirit of St. John.

These are concise summaries; read the original school document for the full statements.
